findings.text: `test_context_cases` now loads the fixture `DeleteLastOutput`, but `tests/surface_fixture_roots.json` does not list it under `surfaceSelect` and no listed fixture imports it, so the closure in `build-support/surface-fixtures.nix` leaves the file out of the `surfaceSelect` Nix suite and the new test has no fixture there. Fix: add `"DeleteLastOutput"` to the `surfaceSelect` list in `tests/surface_fixture_roots.json`.

The docstring of `test_context_cases` lost the sentence that named what the `DeleteReadComparison` fixture checks, although that fixture stays in the module chain. Fix: keep a sentence that says `DeleteReadComparison` compares the DELETE-then-SELECT program with the filtered SELECT on every shop database, next to the new `DeleteLastOutput` sentence.
